mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hose to complete the claw was most worthwhile: the final motion shows how the assembled parts work together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two cups was clear but somewhat repetitive, although the second ring and longer support distinguished the changes.

surprise.text: The completed motion clarified that the jaws reopen as well as close, with the rods pivoting and the syringe rod moving.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each goal named the next fitting. The text did not explain the return band's function, though its placement was clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another moving mechanism: joining the syringe and claw was rewarding, even if the sequential fittings involved few decisions. Text alone cannot establish how recognizable or tactile the pieces are.
